name: Creamy Chicken & Mushroom Soup with Rice

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg cremini mushrooms
6 medium carrots
3 sticks celery
1 small pkg fresh thyme

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Peel and small dice onions. Transfer both to a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 ½ medium yellow onions

instructions.primary_message: Slice mushrooms and add to the bowl.
Peel and slice carrots into thin rounds. Trim and small dice celery. Add both to the bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add veggies to the pot and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 7-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, medium dice chicken and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard stems.
Add chicken and thyme to the pot and cook, stirring occasionally, 4-5 minutes.
Add flour to the pot and stir to coat the vegetables and chicken. Cook, stirring frequently, 1-2 minutes.
Add broth, milk, rice, and salt to the pot. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until rice is soft and chicken is cooked through, 15-20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1774 ml chicken or vegetable broth
710 ml whole milk
1 ½ cups basmati rice
2 tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide soup between bowls and enjoy!
